description: Use this when someone asks which companies hold earnings calls on a day or in a date range, for example this week, across the market or on one exchange. Give it dates (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC; default the next seven days) and optionally an exchange. Returns calls in time order with company and 6ix.com link, and how many calls the range holds; pass the answer's nextCursor as cursor until hasMore is false to get every call in the range.

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

exchange.description: Only companies listed on this exchange, e.g. NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, TSE

page.description: Pages of `limit` calls in time order

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included (default: a week from the first day; at most 31 days)

name: get_earnings_calendar

fiscalPeriod.description: Fiscal quarter the results call covers, e.g. Q2 2026

transcript.description: The call's text can be read with get_earnings_call_transcript

first.description: Position of this answer's first call in the range, from 1

hasMore.description: More follow: ask again with cursor set to nextCursor

listChanged.description: The list changed since the cursor was made and the last item shown is no longer in it, so an item may repeat or be missed here

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on from the last item shown; null at the end

total.description: Every call 6ix lists in the range (and exchange)

title: Earnings call calendar
